create_AABBReceptacle: create an AABBReceptacle with bounds and optional rotation to sample object placements in a scene
sample_uniform_global: sample a uniform random point from an AABBReceptacle in global space using the simulator
parse_receptacles_from_user_config: parse receptacle metadata from a user subconfig and return a list of Receptacle objects
find_receptacles: find all receptacles defined in the scene metadata for rigid and articulated objects
create_ReceptacleTracker: create a ReceptacleTracker to manage object counts per receptacle and exclude full receptacles
